en: An old sepia-toned postcard showing a two‑storey wooden railway station building with a metal roof and several chimneys. The front facade faces the railway tracks in the foreground. A group of people, including children, stand on the platform in front of the station. Trees and a lake or river are visible in the background. Printed at the top is the caption identifying the station, and a station nameboard is mounted on the building.
